summary: The wrapper's static controls pass all requested anti-pattern checks. The required overlay-bound runtime artifacts were directory-listed but not readable/existent through Test-Path at audit time, so their manifest/queue/hash binding could not be verified dynamically. Formal review/finalization must not proceed until those artifacts are restored and verify-queue passes.

At audit time Test-Path returned false for review_queue_v2_pid_non_scoring_overlay_bound.jsonl, queue_manifest_v2_pid_non_scoring_overlay_bound.json, review_template_v2_pid_non_scoring_overlay_bound.jsonl, queue_overlay_binding_self_validation_v2.json, and synthetic_validator_finalizer_smoke_v1.json.

Their names were visible in directory enumeration/rg results, but opening or hashing them failed with path-not-found; therefore the v2 queue, manifest hashes, and recorded self-validation cannot be independently verified.

The only readable queue/manifest in this score root were review_queue.jsonl and queue_manifest.json, whose schema_version is the old codex_manual_action_claim_review_v2 and whose queue is intentionally an overlayless source queue.
checks.required_repair: Restore or regenerate the missing overlay-bound artifacts without overwriting v1 or existing v2 names. Then run the wrapper verify-queue command against the bound queue, bound manifest, and authoritative overlay; retain its new create-only report and re-run this audit. Do not use review_queue.jsonl as a formal review/finalize queue.

formal_use_gate: BLOCKED: runtime artifact availability must be repaired and the overlay-bound bundle must verify before any formal review validation or finalization.
